name: Helldivers 2
notes: If the game won't start on GE-Proton or Proton-CachyOS, switch back to the Steam default Proton (the anti-cheat is picky). The game is very CPU-heavy, so GameMode helps. AMD: the game runs in DirectX 11 mode, which is smoother on Radeon cards (the in-game upscalers need DirectX 12).
